summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ltd., an Indian pharmaceutical company, filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on July 10, 2026, solely to provide a link to an audio recording of a conference call held July 9, 2026. The filing contains no material transaction or special situation—it is a routine informational notice under SEBI listing regulations. No deal terms, prices, stakes, premiums, advisors, or structural mechanics are presented. This is an ordinary disclosure of a conference call recording, not a special-situation event. No further action or risk-arb angle applies.
